Eslamdoust (2026; TR-79) DBH-height model for Ontario white pine plantations

Source: R/hd_eslamdoust2026b.R
hd_eslamdoust2026b.Rd

Predicts total tree height (m) for plantation-origin white pine (PINU.STR) in Ontario from DBH and stand height, basal area and density. This is the TR-79 model, not the natural-stand models in hd_eslamdoust2026().

Usage

hd_eslamdoust2026b(
  DBH,
  species = "PINU.STR",
  HDOM,
  BA,
  TPH,
  keep_model_id = FALSE
)

Arguments

DBH

Numeric vector. Tree level. Diameter at breast height (1.3 m), in cm. Must be >= 0.

species

Character vector. Tree level. NFI species code; only "PINU.STR" (white pine, Pinus strobus) is supported. Compact "PINUSTR" is accepted. Defaults to "PINU.STR".

HDOM

Numeric vector. Plot level. Stand height (m), mean height of dominant and codominant trees (source SHT, p. 2). The source does not specify the species basis. Must be > 0.

BA

Numeric vector. Plot level. Stand basal area (m2/ha; source BAH, p. 2). The source does not specify the minimum tree-size threshold or species basis. Must be > 0.

TPH

Numeric vector. Plot level. Trees per hectare with DBH \(\ge\) 2.5 cm (source TPH, Equation 1, p. 4). The source does not specify the species basis. Must be > 0.

keep_model_id

Logical scalar. If TRUE, add model_id.

Value

A tibble with height (m) and, if keep_model_id = TRUE, model_id ("eslamdoust2026b").

Details

The modified Chapman-Richards equation (Equation 1, p. 4) is $$H = 1.3 + \alpha_0 HDOM^{\alpha_1} [1 - \exp(-\alpha_2 (TPH / BA)^{\alpha_3} DBH)]^{\alpha_4}.$$ Population predictions use the mixed-model fixed effects (Table 2, p. 7), with the plot random effect on \(\alpha_0\) set to zero. Plot-specific calibration is not implemented.

Fitted to 2,265 trees in 41 Ontario plots. Fitting ranges (Table 1, p. 3) are DBH 2.9-58.50 cm, HDOM 4.57-33.56 m, BA 7.55-53.84 m2/ha and TPH 433-4,700 stems/ha. Inputs outside these ranges are computed with a single extrapolation warning. The report notes increased bias above DBH 50 cm and in the highest relative-height classes.

Inputs recycle to a common length; incompatible lengths raise an error. Rows with NA in any input return NA height.

References

Eslamdoust, J. 2026. Height-diameter model for white pine plantations in Ontario. Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources, Science and Research Branch, Peterborough, ON. Science and Research Technical Report TR-79. 12 p.

See also

hd_eslamdoust2026(), hd_model_registry(), get_hd_model_info()

Examples

hd_eslamdoust2026b(DBH = c(10, 20, 30), HDOM = 18, BA = 30, TPH = 1500)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 1
#>   height
#>    <dbl>
#> 1   12.0
#> 2   15.7
#> 3   17.7
hd_eslamdoust2026b(
  DBH = 25, species = "PINU.STR", HDOM = 20, BA = 35, TPH = 1200,
  keep_model_id = TRUE
)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#>   height model_id       
#>    <dbl> <chr>          
#> 1   18.5 eslamdoust2026b
